text:
amy: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR to tidy up the model variant grid on the catalog page. It fixes a couple of broken benchmark links and clarifies the limits column for concurrency and longcontext. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721 :eyes:

jonathan: Thanks — skimmed it. The new grid layout looks cleaner. Two small asks: 1) can we add a note about quantized fallback behavior for low-memory instances, 2) the bench CSV link 404s for nebula3b.

amy: Good catches. I updated the fallback note to mention "quant fallback to int8-compatible variants" and where we recommend `--batch-window` changes. I'll repush.

priya: Re: bench CSV — looks like the artifact path changed after the perf job rename. I can reupload the CSV and update the permalink. Will do in ~20m.

marco: Also noticed the SDK example for listing supported variants still uses the old `list_models()` call. We should switch it to the new `catalog.list_variants()` example and show the limits keys (`max_tokens`, `max_sequence`, `concurrency`). Small snippet suggestion below: 

```python
from redwood import CatalogClient
client = CatalogClient()
for v in client.list_variants("nebula3b"):
    print(v["name"], v["limits"])
```

marco: That snippet is intentionally tiny — docs maintainers can expand later with pagination example.

amy: Great — include that in the PR. Also add a one-liner about deprecating the legacy "orion-xl-legacy" variant — product asked to surface migration steps.

jonathan: For migration steps can we add: 1) pin to the newer `orion-xl-v2` in runtime config, 2) run a small eval set to compare logits with `--temperature 0.0` to catch tokenization shifts, 3) roll forward with canary at 5% traffic for 24hrs. Short bullet list will do.

priya: Uploaded bench CSV and fixed permalink. New link: https://artifacts.redwood-inference/benchmarks/nebula3b/2026-03-23/nebula3b_throughput.csv. Replaced the broken link in the PR.

amy: Thanks! I've pushed the snippet update and migration bullets. I also added a compatibility note: "quantized variants may expose reduced max_sequence; check variant limits before pinning".

sanjay: Quick note from infra: if folks reference per-GPU throughput numbers in the table, we should add the machine type and batch profile used for the benchmark (e.g., a100-40gb, seq 1024, dynamic batching disabled). Otherwise readers confuse nominal per-token numbers.

amy: Good point — added a mini footnote row in the grid with the bench rig and settings.

jonathan: docs-bot flagged one lint error in the table cell width. @docs-bot can you paste the error?

docs-bot: Table cell width exceeds 120 characters in /catalog/variants.md line 243. Suggest wrapping bench notes or moving them to a footnote.

amy: Fixed — split bench notes into a footnote and shortened the inline text. Pushed.

marco: One more: we have an outdated link in the SDK reference that sends users to the old CLI page. I can open a tiny follow-up PR that changes the href to /sdk/python/catalog. Want me to include it in this PR or a separate?

priya: Separate PR is fine — faster to land the catalog grid cleanup and then patchlinks in a follow-up.

jonathan: Approving once the bench CSV link and snippet are in the PR. Leaving review comments on a couple of wording nitpicks.

amy: Thanks — responding to nits now.

priya: Re-uploaded artifact with corrected header (bench CSV had a mislabeled column `throughput_per_gpu` -> `throughput_per_device`). Updated PR.

amy: Nice catch. Anything else blocking?

marco: No blockers from docs side. I verified that the snippet runs locally against the dev catalog API.

sanjay: infra approves the bench footnote and the rig annotation. No issues.

jonathan: Approved. Landing after CI passes. :shipit:

amy: Thanks everyone — will merge once CI is green. Post-merge task: follow-up PR for the SDK link and an extra migration test snippet showing how to run the `--temperature 0.0` diff locally (small shell command).

marco: I'll pick that follow-up PR.

amy: Closing loop here — final PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721 (will update post-merge with final artifact timestamps).
